# Story 01 — Customer Portal: Submit & Track Tickets (Story: CRM-103)

## Prerequisites

- Existing ticket domain (`backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/`) and customer domain (`backend/CRM.Api/Customers/`) are in place and functional.
- Existing auth (`backend/CRM.Api/Auth/`) issues JWTs with role claims; `Roles.cs` defines the current role set.
- Existing frontend ticket module (`frontend/CRM.Web/src/modules/tickets/`), ticket store, ticket API client and shared i18n (`en/common.json`, `ar/common.json`) are in place.
- Coordinate with owners of `CustomerDbContext` and `TicketDbContext` before adding any new column, migration, or role.

---

## Story Goal

Deliver a customer-facing portal that lets an authenticated **Customer** user:

1. Land on a customer dashboard with ticket counts by status and a "recent tickets" list.
2. Submit a new support ticket for themselves.
3. See a list of **only their own** tickets.
4. Open one of their tickets and read status + conversation/history visible to customers.

Reuse the existing `Ticket` entity, ticket creation logic, ticket details logic and ticket conversation logic. Add a thin **`/api/customer/tickets*`** surface that resolves the current customer from the authenticated identity server-side and refuses cross-customer access. Add customer-scoped Vue routes/views under a new `modules/customerPortal/` folder that consume this surface. Reuse existing status/priority components, layout, and i18n.

**Not in scope:** customer satisfaction/feedback (PORTAL-004), analytics, real-time notifications, new chat infra, internal-notes visibility for customers, advanced filtering beyond what the existing ticket store already offers.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current CRM (internal):** agents/admins list, filter and manage every ticket across every customer.
- **New portal behaviour:** an authenticated **Customer** sees only tickets whose `Ticket.CustomerId == currentCustomerId` (resolved server-side from the JWT). Any URL manipulation to another id returns **404** — not 403 — to avoid leaking existence.
- **Internal notes / internal history entries / assignee identity / SLA policy metadata must not appear** in portal responses.
- The customer may create a ticket with `Subject`, `Description`, and (only if the existing model already accepts it from a non-agent) `Priority` and `Category`. Status is always initialized by the backend.

### 2 — Current-customer resolver

**Create file:** `backend/CRM.Api/CustomerPortal/CurrentCustomerAccessor.cs`

```csharp
public interface ICurrentCustomerAccessor
{
    Task<int?> GetCurrentCustomerIdAsync(HttpContext ctx, CancellationToken ct);
}
```

- Implementation reads `ctx.User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)`, loads the `User` from `AuthDbContext`, returns `User.CustomerId`.
- Register as a scoped service in `Program.cs`.
- **Do not** accept a customer id from route/body/query anywhere in the portal endpoints.

### 3 — Authorization policy

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api/Program.cs`

- In `AddAuthorization(...)` add:

```csharp
options.AddPolicy("CustomerPortal", p => p.RequireRole(Roles.Customer));
```

- Keep all existing policies intact. Existing agent/admin policies must remain the authoritative gate for `/api/tickets/*` (the internal surface).

### 4 — Customer portal endpoints

**Create file:** `backend/CRM.Api/CustomerPortal/CustomerPortalEndpoints.cs`

Expose exactly three endpoints under `app.MapGroup("/api/customer").RequireAuthorization("CustomerPortal")`:

```csharp
GET  /api/customer/dashboard          -> DashboardDto
GET  /api/customer/tickets            -> IReadOnlyList<CustomerTicketListItemDto>
GET  /api/customer/tickets/{id:int}   -> CustomerTicketDetailsDto
POST /api/customer/tickets            -> CustomerTicketDetailsDto (201)
```

Behaviour:

- Every handler first calls `ICurrentCustomerAccessor.GetCurrentCustomerIdAsync`. If null → `Results.Forbid()`.
- `GET /dashboard` returns `{ openCount, pendingCount, resolvedCount, recentTickets[0..5] }` computed against `TicketDbContext.Tickets.Where(t => t.CustomerId == currentCustomerId)`.
- `GET /tickets` returns list ordered by `UpdatedAt desc`.
- `GET /tickets/{id}` returns 404 (not 403) when the ticket does not exist **or** belongs to another customer.
- `POST /tickets` forces `CustomerId = currentCustomerId`, ignores any `customerId` field the client sent, initializes status via the same helper the internal create uses. Reuse the internal create service — do **not** copy-paste EF logic.

**Create file:** `backend/CRM.Api/CustomerPortal/CustomerPortalContracts.cs`

DTOs:

```csharp
public record CustomerTicketListItemDto(int Id, string Subject, string Status, string? Priority, DateTime CreatedAt, DateTime UpdatedAt);

public record CustomerTicketDetailsDto(
    int Id, string Subject, string Description, string Status, string? Priority,
    DateTime CreatedAt, DateTime UpdatedAt,
    IReadOnlyList<CustomerTicketMessageDto> Messages,
    IReadOnlyList<CustomerTicketHistoryDto> History);

public record CustomerTicketMessageDto(int Id, string AuthorRole, string Body, DateTime CreatedAt);
public record CustomerTicketHistoryDto(int Id, string Kind, string Summary, DateTime CreatedAt);

public record CreateCustomerTicketRequest(string Subject, string Description, string? Priority, string? Category);

public record CustomerDashboardDto(int OpenCount, int PendingCount, int ResolvedCount, IReadOnlyList<CustomerTicketListItemDto> RecentTickets);
```

- Message projection **excludes** any message with `IsInternal == true` (or equivalent flag confirmed in step 10 of Context).
- History projection **excludes** entries whose `Kind` denotes internal-only events (assignment changes, internal notes) — enumerate the safe kinds in a private `IsPortalVisible(TicketHistoryEntry)` helper.
- No SLA policy details, no assignee identity, no internal-note references leak into these DTOs.

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api/Program.cs`

- Wire the new endpoints once: `app.MapCustomerPortalEndpoints();` after existing ticket mapping.

### 5 — Guard the internal ticket surface

**File:** `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/TicketEndpoints.cs`

- Confirm the internal `/api/tickets` group has `.RequireAuthorization(...)` that requires an **agent/admin** role (not `Customer`). If it currently allows any authenticated user, tighten it so a `Customer` JWT cannot reach the internal endpoints. Do not change agent/admin behaviour.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **User has role `Customer` but no `CustomerId` linked** (mis-provisioned account). Trigger: `ICurrentCustomerAccessor` returns null. Behaviour: all four portal endpoints return `403`; frontend shows `portal.errors.unauthorized` with a "Try again" button. Enforced in `CustomerPortalEndpoints.cs`.
- **URL tampering** (`GET /api/customer/tickets/{id}` with someone else's id). Behaviour: return `404 NotFound` (do not leak existence). Enforced in the details handler.
- **Customer tries to hit `/api/tickets/...`** (internal surface) with a valid customer JWT. Behaviour: `403` — the internal group's policy requires agent/admin role. See Task 5.
- **`POST /api/customer/tickets` body contains `customerId`**. Behaviour: ignored; the handler overwrites with the resolved current customer id.
- **Ticket has internal messages/history entries.** Behaviour: filtered out of `Messages`/`History` in the DTO projection. Enforced in `CustomerPortalContracts.cs` projection helper.
- **Empty ticket list.** Frontend renders empty-state copy and CTA (`portal.tickets.empty` + `emptyCta`).
- **API failure / network drop.** Store sets `error`; view shows `portal.tickets.error` + retry action that re-invokes the store action.
- **Unicode / RTL subjects.** Existing i18n direction handling already covers this; verify the details view renders RTL Arabic subjects correctly.
- **Concurrent create clicks.** Disable the submit button while the store's `creating` flag is true.
- **Half-applied migration state** (see Migration section) — the `Customer` role or `CustomerId` column may be missing on old databases; the accessor treats missing column as "no customer linked" and 403s cleanly.
- **Uncertainty flagged for executor:** confirm whether existing `TicketMessage`/`TicketHistoryEntry` carry an "internal" flag. If not, add a nullable `IsInternal` bool with default `false`, or gate visibility by `Kind` — decide before coding Task 4.

## Migration / Rollback

- **New EF migration** `AddCustomerIdToUsers` in `backend/CRM.Api/Auth/Migrations/`. Column is nullable — safe to apply on existing data.
- **Seed / provisioning:** add a dev-only seed that creates one `Customer` role user linked to an existing `Customer` row so tests and manual QA can log in. Production customer provisioning is out of scope.
- **Half-applied state:** if the migration is applied but `Roles.Customer` is not yet deployed, no user will hold the role, so the portal endpoints simply reject with 403 — no data corruption. If the code ships before the migration is applied, `ICurrentCustomerAccessor` must catch the missing-column error and return null; log at Warning.
- **Rollback:** revert the migration (drop `CustomerId` column) and redeploy previous binaries. No data loss — the column is additive and unused by the internal surface.

## Verification Steps

1. **Backend builds:** `dotnet build backend/CRM.Api/CRM.Api.csproj`.
2. **Backend tests:** `dotnet test backend/CRM.Api.Tests/CRM.Api.Tests.csproj`.
3. **Apply migration locally:** `dotnet ef database update --project backend/CRM.Api`.
4. **Frontend runs:** `npm --prefix frontend/CRM.Web run dev`.
5. **Frontend tests:** `npm --prefix frontend/CRM.Web run test:unit`.
6. **Frontend type-check + lint:** `npm --prefix frontend/CRM.Web run build`.
7. **Manual smoke — customer login:** log in as the seeded customer user; land on `/portal/dashboard`; verify metrics and recent list show only that customer's tickets.
8. **Manual smoke — submit ticket:** submit a new ticket; confirm success toast with ticket id; confirm the ticket appears in `/portal/tickets` and is persisted.
9. **Manual smoke — details:** open a ticket; verify status, messages and history are visible and free of internal notes / assignee identity.
10. **Manual smoke — cross-customer isolation:** with the customer JWT, `GET /api/customer/tickets/{someoneElsesId}` → 404. `GET /api/tickets` (internal) → 403.
11. **Regression:** agent login still lands on internal dashboard; internal ticket list unchanged; existing tests all green.

## Done Criteria

- [ ] Customer can log in and reach `/portal/dashboard`.
- [ ] Dashboard shows Open / Pending / Resolved counts and recent tickets for the current customer only.
- [ ] Customer can submit a ticket via `/portal/tickets/new` and sees a confirmation with the ticket id.
- [ ] Submitted ticket is persisted with `CustomerId` bound to the authenticated identity, ignoring any client-supplied id.
- [ ] Customer can list their tickets via `/portal/tickets` with subject, status, priority (when present), created and updated dates.
- [ ] Customer can open a ticket and view status + customer-visible messages and history.
- [ ] `GET /api/customer/tickets/{id}` returns 404 for any ticket the caller does not own.
- [ ] `Customer` JWTs are rejected from `/api/tickets/*`; agent/admin JWTs are rejected from `/api/customer/*`.
- [ ] Internal notes, assignee identity, SLA policy metadata and internal history entries are absent from all portal responses.
- [ ] Empty state renders when the customer has no tickets.
- [ ] Loading and error states render on dashboard, list, details, and submit.
- [ ] English and Arabic strings exist for every new portal key; RTL layout verified.
- [ ] Portal renders on desktop, tablet and mobile widths.
- [ ] No new `Ticket` entity introduced; internal ticket endpoints unchanged for agents/admins.
- [ ] PORTAL-004 (customer feedback/satisfaction) is **not** implemented.
- [ ] All backend and frontend tests pass locally.
